proofs.text: Read every file under `specs/` and, for each line under its `## Proof` heading that starts a list item, verify it matches `PROOF-\d+ \(RULE-\d+\)`; a line that does not fails naming the file and the line

rule_text: A proof line reads `PROOF-N (RULE-N)`, and names several rules as `PROOF-N (RULE-A, RULE-B)` when one flow drives all of them

tests.name: test_all_proof_lines_match_pattern
